name: Superboof 0.5g Live Rosin Disposable
description: Lineage: Black Cherry Punch x Tropicanna Cookies F2 Type: Hybrid Terpenes: Limonene, ß-Myrcene, ß-Caryophyllene Aroma: Sweet Cherry, Citrusy, Tropical Effects: Euphoric, Creative, Relaxed Rev your engines with Superboof, a strain that’s built for a high-performance experience. Like a finely tuned engine, this hybrid kicks into gear with a sweet cherry aroma, paired with a sharp citrus tang and a burst of tropical flair. The effects hit fast, delivering a euphoric rush that sparks creativity and focus, followed by a smooth, relaxed glide that keeps you in control. Whether you're cruising through a creative project or just kicking back after a busy day, Superboof keeps you running smooth and steady, with just the right amount of power to take you where you need to go.
